prompt:
A horizontal sprite sheet animation strip laid out as a strict grid of 4 columns and 2 rows (8 equal square cells), read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Wide 2:1 aspect ratio overall.

Every cell shows the SAME steampunk horizontal straight pipe in the EXACT same position and size; only the glowing blue water inside changes from cell to cell, animating water flowing through the pipe from left to right. Frame 1 (top-left) = empty pipe (no water). Frames progress with more bright cyan-blue bubbly water flowing through, frame 8 (bottom-right) = pipe completely full of flowing water. The animation should loop seamlessly (the bubbles/flow read as continuous motion).

Each cell contains a horizontal glass tube pipe with brass/copper flanges at the LEFT and RIGHT openings. The pipe is centered vertically: both openings sit exactly on the vertical middle of the cell and reach all the way to the left and right edges so pipes connect edge-to-edge. The pipe art sits on a fully TRANSPARENT background (no metal backplate, no square tile — just the pipe with alpha transparency around it).

Art style: match the provided reference — glossy glass tube, polished brass ring flanges with rivets, glowing electric-blue water with small bubbles and highlights, clean industrial steampunk game UI art, crisp high detail. Keep the pipe perfectly identical and aligned in all 8 cells; ONLY the water level/flow changes.
